items.where: Harvesting water from roofs, step 3 (first-flush diverter)
items.backtranslation: Throw it away after every rain (the pipe/container itself, by class-9 concord).
items.problem: '-lahla' with a class 9 object concord reads as discarding the diverter, not emptying its water.

items.where: Where not to dig swales - Near buildings
items.english: never uphill of a pit toilet, septic tank or soak-away
items.draft: ungaze uzibeke ngaphezulu kwendlu yangasese engumngxuma, itanki ye-septic okanye i-soak-away
items.backtranslation: never put them above (on top of) a pit toilet, septic tank or soak-away
items.problem: 'ngaphezulu kwe-' is ambiguous (over/on top vs. uphill); safety point about contamination running downhill was lost.
items.corrected: ungaze uzibeke ethambekeni ngaphezulu kwendlu yangasese engumngxuma, itanki ye-septic okanye i-soak-away

items.english: Blackwater and nappy water carry germs and never go on the garden.
items.backtranslation: ...carry germs and are not put in the garden.
items.problem: Prohibition softened to a descriptive statement ('never' lost) in a sanitation-safety sentence.

items.english: Never near, or uphill of, a well, borehole or spring.
items.draft: Ungaze ibe kufutshane okanye ngaphezulu komthombo obiweyo (well), komngxuma wamanzi (borehole) okanye komthombo wendalo (spring).
items.backtranslation: Never near or above a well, borehole or spring.
items.problem: 'uphill of' rendered ambiguously as 'above'; drinking-water safety rule.
items.corrected: Ungaze ibe kufutshane okanye ethambekeni ngaphezulu komthombo obiweyo (well), komngxuma wamanzi (borehole) okanye komthombo wendalo (spring).
